reuse.why: The diff reuses getApproxNumberThreshold but bypasses the existing getScheduledAmount abstraction instead of extending shared schedule amount policy.

duplication.why: API serialization and preview generation independently implement missing, numeric, approximate, and ranged amount selection.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but scheduleModel.toExternal embeds its own domain decision in the API mapping layer.

scope.why: All edits concern expected schedule amounts, their API representation, or preview tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate multiple inline amount policies that have already diverged between API serialization and previews.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in shared/schedules.ts independently dispatch on amounts rather than extending and using getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The expectedAmount expression in server/api-models.ts and amount expression in shared/schedules.ts repeat the same decision structure with differently expressed endpoint and tolerance selection.

abstraction_drift.where: The API and preview consumers implement amount policy independently of getScheduledAmount; subsequent rule changes update only the preview implementation.
